title: Nutty Creamy Korean Clotted Cream Bibimbap
description: A Korean-inspired brunch dish featuring nutty, creamy clotted cream atop a bed of mixed vegetables and crispy rice, finished with a smoky kick.
instructions: Toast brown rice according to package instructions. Set aside.
Roast sesame seeds in the oven for 5 minutes, or until fragrant.
Grill portobello mushrooms for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
In a small saucepan, warm smoked Gochujang sauce over low heat.
In a large skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add sliced cucumber, carrots, and zucchini to the skillet. Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add grilled portobello mushrooms to the skillet and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of toasted brown rice in the bottom of a bowl.
Add a layer of mixed vegetables on top of the brown rice.
Drizzle smoked Gochujang sauce and sesame oil over the vegetables.
Top with roasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions.
Dollop clotted cream on top of the dish and serve immediately.
